SN1.detail: Every criterion states a threshold the business would accept. The one requiring judgement is A-013, where readability of the source is bounded by a raw-markup line count relative to the pre-change file rather than an absolute limit, so the outcome is constrained without the notation being dictated. A-007 and A-008 set review thresholds over a named, closed list of affordances rather than over a general impression.

SN2.detail: No silent widening. All eight in-scope items trace to a statement in the feature request, including S-004, which restates the request's own sentence that preserving the design affordances is part of the deliverable. Adjacent work that a reader could assume was included is pushed to X-001 through X-007 rather than absorbed, and the two matters the inputs leave undecided are recorded as Q-001 and Q-002 rather than resolved by assumption.

SN3.detail: The business goal is the requester's own, drawn from the request's Problem section, which states that the two published forms are hand-synchronised, that nothing checks their agreement, and that the fix is to make one the source and fail CI on a stale output. No goal was inferred for the requester and no mechanism is named in the goal.

scope_decision_owned_and_recorded.question: whether preserving the published handbook's existing design affordances is inside this change's boundary
scope_decision_owned_and_recorded.rationale_summary: A byte comparison checks the published file against a regeneration of itself, so it cannot detect a degraded published artifact and would pass a stripped-down page as readily as the current one. D-001 places preservation inside the boundary and makes acceptance depend on review as well as on bytes. D-002 narrows the no-content-in-exactly-one-file criterion to authored content, because a literal reading is unsatisfiable for a markup form and would force deletion of the very affordances D-001 protects. D-006 records that preservation is accepted by review, with X-006 naming the automated visual regression check that is deliberately excluded and the condition that would bring it back.
